about: VSS combined confidence and its thresholds for the demo (docs/js/vss-confidence.js), for the VSS worlds of arm refit (FEEDBACK_PLAN.md, FEEDBACK_RESULT.md). Weights, intercept, percentile tables, world prior and thresholds: fitted on the fresh2 calibration part (training/sketch/llm_bench/fresh2/opus_a..d, messages with int(sha256(id), 16) % 3 == 0) by training/sketch/fresh2/fit_report.mjs (EXPORT) from the arm's records (gpu-runs:results/072_measure/refit/records/vss_arm.jsonl), written by training/sketch/fresh2/export_confidence.mjs. A refit replaces this file only (no code change) and training/sketch/stamp_models.py gives it a new version.
protocol: FRESH2_PLAN.md / FEEDBACK_PLAN.md: confidences fitted on the fresh2 calibration part only (368 messages, 808 requested actions); the default level "cost" is the threshold that maximises the cost score (one confident mistake = 10 right answers, AGENTS.md) on the out-of-fold calibration confidences; the 95/97/99 levels are the lowest threshold whose out-of-fold precision of execution is >= the level with >= 50 executed. The test part (745 messages, 1745 requested actions) is only scored.

vss_combined.confidence: logistic over 14 named stage signals, each a percentile of its distribution on the calibration part (see features, tables); the recipe 'logistic all minus event' of VSS_CONFIDENCE.md (the event stage left out), refitted for arm refit by training/sketch/fresh2/fit_report.mjs. Reference implementation: training/sketch/precision_confidence.mjs. Execute when confidence >= threshold.
vss_combined.how_to: z = intercept + sum(weight_i * percentile_i); confidence = 1/(1+exp(-z)). percentile_i: x = raw signal (world_prior: the table value of the chosen world, else world_prior_default; world 'none' when no world); null/undefined -> 1; binary table -> (sign>0 ? x>0 : x<0.5) ? 1 : 0; else y = x*sign, lo = count of table values < y, eq = count equal to y, percentile = (lo + eq/2)/n. tables[name]: n, sign, binary, values (sorted distinct oriented calibration values), below (number of calibration values strictly below each distinct value).
vss_combined.threshold_source: out-of-fold: each calibration request scored by the model of the 5-fold cross-validation (folds by message) that did not see its fold; L2 10 chosen from {0.01, 0.1, 1, 10} by out-of-fold AUROC (0.779); the weights, intercept, tables and world prior are the final fit on all of the calibration part (742 produced requests). The "cost" level: the threshold that maximises the cost score (requests done right - 10 x (executed wrong + extras executed)) / requested actions x 100 on the out-of-fold confidences (a tie keeps the higher threshold); test part: score 4.8 [3.0, 6.3] (FEEDBACK_RESULT.md, fresh2/VERDICTS.md).
vss_combined.levels_note: levels.cost is the default (the owner's decision 2026-11-02 21:24: execute only what it is sure of, at the cost-score threshold). levels[95|97|99] = null: no threshold reaches that precision of execution on the calibration part's out-of-fold confidences with at least 50 executed; the demo shows the level as not reachable. heldout_* fields: the calibration part (the name is kept from the earlier file); heldout_oof_*: out-of-fold precision / right share / asked share at the threshold; test_*: the test part of fresh2 at the cost threshold (reported, never used to choose). Levels cost5 ('bolder': one confident mistake counts as 5 right answers) and cost20 ('more careful': as 20): the cost-score optimum at that cost on the same out-of-fold calibration confidences (added 2026-11-02 by training/sketch/combine/combined_report.mjs EXPORT=1; the weights are unchanged). Levels cost1 and cost2 (bolder still: one confident mistake counts as 1 or 2 right answers), chosen the same way (added 2026-11-03).
